effect: Beams follow ATK. A cookie missing Milk's buff (often Tea Knight) shifts the order, and a beam jumps to someone without skill amp.
mitigation: Lv.1 fillers, and Scorpion levelled into 7th in ATK as the catcher. Check in battle: Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK on entry.

effect: Where cookies stop decides whether Macaron's crit buff reaches Brightseeker and whether Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's.
mitigation: Cherry forces a straight line; or tune move speed to 0.01 (Melon Soda deck), which still misaligns about 1 run in 4, varying by device.

effect: Records take long sessions: 35 tries for 439G, ~100 runs for 350G, 14 h of macro for 546G. At 1.74G, 1T lands in 1–2 of 10.
mitigation: Budget hours, not minutes. Many top posters run a macro overnight.

effect: Same team, same day: the levelled-filler Cherry account's 100 runs at 2.93G gave 208–783× (mean 477×); 700×+ came once in 20.
mitigation: Score the setup on the median of many runs, not one best; a macro logs no damage, so log by hand first.

effect: Most teams wipe at 17 s left: 43 s of damage. Surviving adds damage no guide accounts for.
mitigation: Survival is possible: Pomegranate alive at 11.4 s (nv:46283); at 21G total power the carries lived to 8 s left (dc:76583).
